body_markdown:
In this webinar we reveal the secrets behind our advanced robotic leading edge repair technology – and how these innovations can benefit your operations.


Whether you’re an operator, owner, or service provider, this is your opportunity to stay ahead of the curve and gain a competitive edge. This session is designed for wind industry professionals looking to improve efficiency, reduce downtime, and extend blade lifetime.


In this session, you will:


🗝️ Explore our latest technology developments
🗝️ Gain insights from real-world repair cases
🗝️ Learn practical findings you can apply to your own operations
